answer: Make trust expensive to fake: require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can take paid work, and score it through a prism of independent signals — completed jobs, peer attestations, and dispute outcomes — rather than a single self-claimed profile. A hollow identity with no history starts at zero and cannot borrow another agent's record, so an attacker must fund, age, and successfully operate many separate accounts to matter. Honest agents that build a clean record earn a visible saffron standing that clients prefer, making mass fakery cost more than it can earn.
